_meta.title: Jadiwangi Laundry Operations & Payment Flow Design Guidelines

tech_stack.frontend: React Native (Expo Router) for Web & Mobile
tech_stack.styling: StyleSheet with custom design tokens (Nunito & Poppins typography)

summary_of_changes.whatsapp_receipts_all_methods: Extend WhatsApp receipt modal and sharing prompt to trigger for Tunai (cash), E-Money (emoney), and QRIS (qris), not QRIS only. Display explicit payment method in receipt modal title and message.
summary_of_changes.payment_form_cancel_button: Add an explicit, high-visibility 'Batal Transaksi' (Cancel) button inside the payment modal before an order is submitted or finalized, allowing cashiers/operators to back out safely without creating an abandoned order.
summary_of_changes.packing_workflow_timeline_navigation: When an order in the queue reaches or is at 'Ke Packing', clicking leads to a dedicated Process Timeline screen displaying the laundry stages: Cuci (washing) -> Pengering (drying) -> Setrika (ironing) -> Packing (packing) with live timestamps, assigned worker, and an action to finalize packing.
summary_of_changes.packing_to_ready_transition: Completing the Packing stage transitions the order to 'ready' (Siap Diambil).
summary_of_changes.clickable_ready_card_and_modal: The 'Siap Diambil' counter stat card at the top of the Employee Home is now interactive (clickable). Clicking it displays a dedicated sheet/list showing all orders currently awaiting customer pickup, complete with customer contact, quick WhatsApp ping, and one-tap 'Selesai (Diambil)' action.

required_updates: Add explicit 'Batal Transaksi' button (`data-testid="btn-cancel-payment"`) in the payment modal before creating an order so users can safely abort without registering a new order.
Ensure payment receipt modal triggers for all payment methods: Tunai ('cash'), QRIS ('qris'), and E-Money ('emoney').
Display dynamic header in the success modal: 'Pembayaran Tunai Berhasil', 'Pembayaran QRIS Berhasil', or 'Pembayaran E-Money Berhasil'.
WhatsApp URL generator must correctly reflect 'Lunas via Tunai', 'Lunas via QRIS', or 'Lunas via E-Money' in WhatsApp receipt message.

For cards in antrian where next step is 'Ke Packing' (status === 'ironing' or packing transition), clicking 'Ke Packing' navigates to the dedicated timeline process page `/order-timeline/[id]` or triggers the timeline modal.
Support WhatsApp receipt popup on inline manual payments across all methods (cash, qris, emoney) with testID `queue-send-whatsapp-receipt`.

order_timeline_screen.description: Dedicated visual workflow timeline for laundry order stages: Cuci -> Pengering -> Setrika -> Packing.

ui_specifications.action_button: Prominent primary action: 'Selesaikan Packing & Pindah ke Siap Diambil' (`data-testid="btn-finish-packing"`). When clicked, updates order status to 'ready' and redirects or refreshes.

required_updates: Make the 'Siap Diambil' stat card at the top clickable with `data-testid="ready-orders-card"`.
When clicked, open a dedicated modal or navigate to a filtered view showing all orders with status 'ready'.

Inside the Ready Orders view (`data-testid="ready-orders-modal"`), list each card with customer name, phone, item count/kg, total payment status, one-tap WhatsApp reminder button (`data-testid="btn-whatsapp-ready-[code]"`), and 'Selesai (Diambil)' action button (`data-testid="btn-complete-pickup-[code]"`).

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 text to background contrast)
accessibility_and_contrast.interactive_touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all mobile touch targets
accessibility_and_contrast.feedback: Use Haptics.notificationAsync on state changes and button triggers on native platforms with safe web fallbacks

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT hardcode WhatsApp URLs without encoding parameters properly with encodeURIComponent.
Ensure the 'Batal Transaksi' button closes the payment modal, resets error states, and does NOT generate any order or transaction record.
Implement the full timeline route `/order-timeline/[id]` or equivalent Expo Router path so employees navigating from 'Ke Packing' get a distinct and clear visual roadmap of the laundry stages.
Ensure when 'Packing' finishes, the status updates to 'ready' (Siap Diambil) in the database and invalidates the query client cache for orders and dashboard.
The 'Siap Diambil' counter on the employee dashboard must have `testID="ready-orders-card"` and open the ready orders list.
All new interactive elements must implement the corresponding `data-testid` attributes defined in the matrix.
